scope: reviewed main-image ranges; omissions remain unknown

ranges.evidence: ROM entry descriptor; MOVA produces 0x0c021010, mask/OR selects uncached alias 0xac021010; JMP plus delay slot.
Uncached startup alias; cache-control write then clear loops. BT at 0x0c021040 skips the inline literal, BRA at 0x0c021044 loops with a delay slot.
MOV.L at 0x0c02103c loads this zero literal; neither successor of startup control flow executes it.
BT target from 0x0c021040; initializes stack/registers, JSR at 0x0c02108e and final self-BRA at 0x0c021092 with delay slot.
MOVA at 0x0c021026 reads first two words as clear-region address/size; MOVA at 0x0c02104c reads stack and call target; MOV.L at 0x0c021038/3a read BSS bounds.
PC-relative MOV.L at 0x0c021002/006/010/012 reads the four 32-bit mask, alias and cache-control constants.
Function entry with BSR callers at 0x0c021378, 0x0c0213aa, 0x0c02148a, and 0x0c0214fa. Direct branches remain in the function and the BRA at 0x0c021166 skips the following literal pool.

MOV.W at 0x0c021144 and PC-relative MOV.L instructions at 0x0c0210d2, 0x0c0210e6, 0x0c0210f2, 0x0c0210fe, 0x0c021108, and 0x0c02112e consume this pool; branches enter code at 0x0c021180 or skip to 0x0c02120a.

Conditional target from 0x0c021162 resumes this function after its inline pool. All direct branches stay inside and converge on the epilogue ending with RTS at 0x0c021276 and its delay slot at 0x0c021278.
PC-relative MOV.W, MOV.L, and MOVA instructions in 0x0c021180..0x0c021278 consume the constants and pointers through 0x0c0212a4; code ends before this pool and the next function starts at 0x0c0212a8.
Callee-save prologue starts at 0x0c0212a8. Direct paths either branch to later code at 0x0c0213ec/0x0c021440 or to the shared epilogue at 0x0c021552; BRA at 0x0c0213c2 skips the inline pool.
PC-relative loads at 0x0c0212ba..0x0c021310 reference every constant/pointer in this pool; the BRA at 0x0c0213c2 and BF at 0x0c02133c transfer around it to code at 0x0c021552 or 0x0c0213ec.
BF at 0x0c02133c targets this continuation of the 0x0c0212a8 function. Its direct paths converge on the shared epilogue, ending with RTS at 0x0c021564 and its delay slot at 0x0c021566.
Two PC-relative MOV.W instructions at 0x0c021440 and 0x0c021442 consume the two constants; the preceding function returns before them and the next entry is 0x0c02156c.
Indirect JSR from boot init at 0x0c0283da/3de via pointer 0x0c02156c; all local BF/BRA targets stay inside the body; RTS at 0x0c0215a8 plus NOP delay slot; no PC-relative pool.
Function begins immediately after the 0x0c02156c return, contains two indirect JSRs and a BSR to 0x0c0212a8, and ends with RTS at 0x0c0215f2 plus its delay slot at 0x0c0215f4.
